meta.title: Tower
meta.description: Plan and track missions, isolate each one in its own worktree, hand the work to worker and reviewer agents, and merge only after review. Off equals uninstalling Tower: no tools, presets or skills remain.

tower.title: Tower host
tower.summary: The always-on core: mission planning and state, worktree isolation, Tower mode, the environment health check, and the lock recovery escape.
tower.disables: Off equals uninstalling Tower: no tools, presets or skills remain.

tower-skills.title: Tower skills
tower-skills.summary: Step-by-step playbooks for worker and reviewer agents, and a guide for getting unstuck when a merge is blocked.
tower-skills.disables: The three Tower skills leave the catalog; the worker and reviewer protocol sections and every mission tool keep working.

tower-batch.title: Evidence batches
tower-batch.summary: Collect a finite set of missions into a batch and close it only when every required check and evidence receipt is present.
tower-batch.disables: Batch tools and their checks are unavailable; missions, merges and every other capability keep working.

tower-import.title: Legacy import
tower-import.summary: Read a legacy Tower Codex state file (the earlier Tower state format) and show how each old snapshot maps to a mission.
tower-import.disables: The import tools are unavailable; current state and every other capability keep working.

tower-leases.title: Lease coordination
tower-leases.summary: Coordination only: lets one agent claim a named piece of shared work (a lease) so two agents do not start the same job. A lease is a note other agents can read; it never blocks work by itself.
tower-leases.disables: Lease tools are unavailable. A worker configured to require a lease cannot start: planning and entering Tower mode are refused with an explanation until that setting is cleared or this row is re-enabled. Everything else keeps working.

tower-tests.title: Test evidence
tower-tests.summary: Run the project's declared test command in a mission's worktree and record the result as evidence for merging.
tower-tests.disables: No test command can be run and no evidence can be recorded. If tests are configured as required before merging, planning and entering Tower mode are refused with an explanation; missions, merges and everything else keep working.

tower-board.title: Mission board
tower-board.summary: Write a plain-text board file (MISSIONS.md) beside the state so a person can read the mission list without calling a tool.
tower-board.disables: The board file is not written or refreshed, so an existing board goes stale; missions, merges and every other capability keep working.

tower-archive.title: Mission archive
tower-archive.summary: Move finished missions and their linked records into the on-disk archive, so the live state file stops carrying their full history.
tower-archive.disables: Finished missions stay in the live state file, so it keeps growing; merges and every other capability keep working, and nothing is deleted.

tower-hmr.title: Development hot reload
tower-hmr.summary: Development-only: reloads Tower in a linked development setup after a code change, so you do not have to restart DSH.
tower-hmr.disables: Nothing reloads automatically; restart the development setup by hand instead. A normal installation is unaffected, because this is developer tooling that ships off on purpose.

preset-tower-worker.title: Tower Worker preset
preset-tower-worker.summary: The mandatory Tower Worker preset: the mission protocol plus the filesystem, shell and Tower tools a worker uses inside its own worktree. Not a switch: Tower depends on it.
preset-tower-worker.disables: Tower cannot plan missions, enter Tower mode, or start a worker without it.

preset-tower-reviewer.title: Tower Reviewer preset
preset-tower-reviewer.summary: The independent Tower Reviewer preset: a read-only reviewer agent that reads the mission diff, checks scope and acceptance, and returns a verdict. Only used when review before merging is required.
preset-tower-reviewer.disables: The reviewer cannot be started. That is supported while review before merging is optional; once it is required, planning and entering Tower mode are refused with an explanation.

tower-ui.title: Tower UI
tower-ui.summary: Adds Tower cards for tool results, a compact status summary above the message box, and a short status strip, in the web client.
tower-ui.disables: The web interface piece is not loaded: no Tower cards, status summary or status strip. The Tower host, missions, state and the board keep working.
